decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Drawing numbers should read: PC-10-025 01, 01, PC-10-025 02 B, 301 A, 03, 101 A received 24/09/2010, supporting statements received 27/09/2010 and 302 A and unnumbered REDLEES PARL: DESIGN PROPOSAL FOR NEW INCLUSIVE ADVENTURE PLAYGROUND received 19/11/2010 and 101 B received 08/12/2010) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until landscape details to show an area within the site suitable for use by younger children has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as a approved and permanently retained.
description: Installation of an adventure playground and log cabin
